text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Requirements met for operating adaptive antennas", "gist": "Adaptive 5G antennas meet the necessary requirements for operation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Ordinance on Protection against Non-Ionising Radiation (NIRO)", "gist": "The legal framework governing non-ionising radiation protection"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "OFCOM", "gist": "The Swiss Federal Office of Communications that conducted the examination"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Mobile network operators' adaptive 5G antennas fulfil the implementing guidelines to the Ordinance on Protection against Non-Ionising Radiation (NIRO)", "gist": "5G adaptive antennas comply with the NIRO guidelines"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Both the automatic power lock and the quality assurance systems of the antennas meet the legal requirements", "gist": "Key safety features of the antennas satisfy legal standards"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This means that the cantons can approve the use of adaptive antennas in mobile networks", "gist": "Cantons are now authorized to permit adaptive antenna deployment"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "First tests and measurements by OFCOM on adaptive antennas (summer 2020)", "gist": "OFCOM conducted initial testing of adaptive antennas in summer 2020"}]}
